R261.note: Ownership check before deleteById closes the IDOR, but returning 403 for an existing non-owned document reveals existence, which the stated contract forbids (deny should look like the existing not-found path).

R262.note: Tika.detect(byte[]) sniffs magic bytes instead of the client-chosen extension; dependency addition stated, allowlist and storage path unchanged (readAllBytes loads the upload into memory where Tika.detect(Path) would not, minor).

R263.note: Positional bind parameters via Sequelize's bind option with QueryTypes.SELECT preserved; query shape and result unchanged.

R264.note: RESP multibulk encoding makes every argument length-prefixed so CRLF/whitespace cannot split commands; same HSET semantics and reply.

R265.note: Caps length against receivedByteCount-2 after the existing <2 check, bounding the memmove read; only previously-invalid messages now return -1.

R266.note: Shell removed, argument array plus absolute PING.EXE and leading-dash rejection close both injection gaps, but the added HOST_PATTERN rejects previously accepted hostnames such as ones containing underscores or an IPv6 zone id.

R267.note: Dropping the template.HTML cast restores html/template contextual escaping; the resulting text-not-markup rendering is the fix and is stated.

R268.note: realpath plus commonpath containment closes traversal, but the added rejection of any '/' or '\' turns away subdirectory paths under BASE_DIR that the original served and no contract rules out.

R269.note: session_regenerate_id() after credential verification and before writing session data closes fixation; return values and flow unchanged.

R270.note: Decoding into a jobWire DTO without IsAdmin keeps the gob format (gob ignores unknown stream fields) and IsAdmin is set server-side, matching the contract.

R271.note: PasswordEncoder.matches against the stored hash gates token creation; the BadCredentialsException change, dummy-hash timing path and new constructor dependency are all stated.

R272.note: snprintf with sizeof(line) closes the overflow; the [TRUNCATED] marker and new return codes (1, -2) are stated and only apply to inputs that previously overflowed.

R273.note: GetFullPath containment with trailing-separator prefix check closes traversal, but the GetFileName equality check rejects subdirectory paths the original served and nothing in the case declares bare-filename-only.
